estimand.epro: E_{p(theta)}[phi(q)] with p ∝ exp(-J(q)/tau) on S^3, gradient via score function E[phi*s], s=-dJ/dtheta/tau
estimand.laplace: sum_k w_k phi(q_k), w_k ∝ exp(-J_k/tau) det(H_k)^(-1/2) (mode-level, same as run_main.laplace)
estimand.bpnp: phi(q_branch(theta)) for one local minimum followed by IFT
estimand.fd: central FD of the same IS estimator mean at independent seeds, n_ref=500000 per side, 2 replications
